To prevent the small positive tails touching a zero line, the drawn baseline is shortened to z=-2 to +2. The omitted baseline portions remain virtual. No vertical floor, artificial tail contact, CDF or area percentages are introduced.", "canvas_mm": [170, 200]}, "teaching": "The exact standard-normal density remains over z=-3.5 to +3.5, with equal one-SD landmark positions from -3 to +3. All seven 13 mm landmark strokes are detached, starting 5 mm below the virtual zero level; their top ends indicate horizontal positions, not positive density values. The omitted baseline portions remain virtual. No vertical floor, artificial tail contact, CDF or area percentages are introduced. These finite diagrams do not prove limiting behaviour.
